column1: # What a greyed item says, and where it takes you: one row for each reason something is off because of a setting or a
# sign-in. The portal's pickers (portal/static/answers.js: the Terminal's Open menu, Chat's Who answers), Home and
# Settings read it through /api/answers (portal/portal/answers.py setup_links); the Code page (its model picker's Who
# answers, its terminal panel's Open…, the mode picker) has the same rows in code/web/src/setuplinks.ts (tests compare
# the two). Each greyed item is a link or a button there: choosing it goes to its target at once.
#   target   setting:KEY — the portal's Settings at that row (scrolled to, highlighted, its switch focused; a key of
#            catalog/settings.tsv) | signin:terminal — the tool itself in the terminal, where its own sign-in starts |
#            signin:chat — Settings › Your AI subscriptions, at that tool's Chat row with its Sign in open
#   says     one sentence: what is off, and where it is turned on (the page shows it as the item's words)

column3: The browser terminal is off: Settings › Claude Code › Browser terminal turns it on.
Not over remote access: Settings › Remote access › Terminal and Code page over remote access turns it on, from the computer running bedrock-now.
Not in the sandbox: Settings › Claude Code › Tools in the sandbox puts it in.
Not signed in: it opens in the terminal, where its own sign-in starts.
Needs the Code page, which runs your subscriptions' agents: Settings › Claude Code › Code page turns it on.
Off while the sandbox has no internet: Settings › Claude Code › Sandbox internet access.
Off: Settings › Claude Code › Your AI subscriptions › Use my Claude plan in the Code page and Chat.
Sign in for Chat: Chat has sign-ins of its own, and Settings › Claude Code › Your AI subscriptions shows how.
Auto is off: Settings › Claude Code › Auto mode turns it on, from the computer running bedrock-now.
Bypass permissions is off: Settings › Claude Code › Allow Bypass permissions turns it on, from the computer running bedrock-now.
OpenRouter's models need your OpenRouter key: Settings › Chat & voice › OpenRouter API key, on the computer running bedrock-now.
Voice calls need speech-to-text: Settings › Chat & voice › Speech-to-text.
Settings › Claude Code › Models for Claude Code picks the models listed here.
